messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Incident created (P1): model-warmup failures detected on runtime-pool-us-west-2. Trigger: 5x increase in load errors and paging across gpu-06..gpu-09. Auto-suspected: deserialization errors + OOM during warmup. Create time 7612345678
maya: ack, I'm on it. seeing paging spike on gpu-07 and repeated model-load failures for model: /catalog/gptx-open-v2-13b
aj (oncall): I'm jumping in. any customer-facing hits?
cs-ops: two customers (acme-corp, finlytics) report elevated 5xx on generation endpoints, rate ~15% errors last 4m. CS investigating with them, flagged for SLA impact.
infra-sre: sharing initial node logs from gpu-07 (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-16T14:05:12Z] runtime: load model /mnt/artifacts/gptx-open-v2-13b
[2026-03-16T14:05:13Z] deser: checksum mismatch for shard-3.bin (expected abc123, got a1b2c3)
[2026-03-16T14:05:13Z] deser: attempting retry 1/3
[2026-03-16T14:05:14Z] runtime: Allocating KV cache 6.2GiB
[2026-03-16T14:05:14Z] cuda: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.9 GiB (GPU 0; 40.00 GiB total, 36.50 GiB free)
[2026-03-16T14:05:15Z] runtime: model warmup failed: OOM during allocate, aborting
```
maya: hm checksum mismatch + OOM. could be artifact corruption combined with evictions causing extra allocations. paging threshold crossed at 14:05:10.
aj (oncall): immediate mitigations we can run?
infra-sre: two fast mitigations: 1) Evict the warmup traffic for gptx-open-v2-13b (disable warmup on routing) 2) Route requests to gptx-open-v2-13b-quant (smaller quantized variant)
ops-bot: running command: `redwood route update --model gptx-open-v2-13b --disable-warmup`
ops-bot: running command: `redwood route fallback --from gptx-open-v2-13b --to gptx-open-v2-13b-quant --priority=high`
maya: applying node-level remediation: draining gpu-07 from warmup pool to stop constant load retries. `kubectl cordon gpu-07 && kubectl drain gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (will be quick).
sam: are we confident the quant variant meets customer quality? CS says finlytics is using long-form completions.
devex: quant model validated for latency/cost; quality regression within accepted thresholds for >90% of prompts. we should notify customers but fallback preserves availability.
cs-ops: notifying customers: message queued for ACME: "we are routing to a fallback model to preserve availability; you may see slight quality differences".
aj (oncall): performing a soft restart of model loader on pool nodes after cordon/drain, targeting gpu-06..09 sequentially to avoid stampede.
infra-sre: note: artifact checksum mismatch indicates possible S3/region replication issue. starting verification job: `artifact-validator --prefix /catalog/gptx-open-v2-13b`
maya: also increasing KV cache eviction aggressiveness for warmups to cut memory use: `runtime-config set kvcache.eviction_ratio 0.25`
ops-bot: route updates confirmed. fallback in effect at 7612345730. Warmup disabled for gptx-open-v2-13b at 7612345742.
cs-ops: error rates dropped to ~3% after fallback, latency nominal +30ms. still monitoring. customers notified (ACME, FinLytics).
sam: any persistent OOMs after drain/restart?
infra-sre: after drain+restart: logs show fewer OOMs but one node (gpu-08) reported compile timeout: `compile: timeout after 2m (kernel opt)` at 7612345820 — restarting runtime on gpu-08 now.
maya: restarting runtime on gpu-08. will watch for paging.
devex: recommend we enable progressive warmup for heavy models (stagger shard loads) as a postmortem action.
aj (oncall): agreed. immediate action items: 1) post-incident validation of artifact checksums for model, 2) fix replication errors if any, 3) add gating so deserialization checksum mismatch triggers pull-from-backup, not full warmup retries.
incident-bot: escalation: handoff to eng-runtime for a full triage. paging alert cleared at 7612345880, cluster error rate stabilized.
cs-ops: final customer update drafted, no SLA credits required yet, monitoring for 1h.
maya: assigning postmortem owner: sam. include timeline, artifact validation, KV cache tuning, and rollout of progressive warmup.
sam: ack, I'll start a postmortem doc and ping eng-runtime/infra for follow-ups.
aj (oncall): closing slack thread for active mitigation. please add notes to incident tracker ID #INC-20260316-004. thanks team :thumbsup:
